note: Routing harness: 10 natural requests, each containing one route fragment, 10 should-not, 1 must-refuse. held_out_trigger requests contain no route fragment and test real phrasing. near_miss names the sibling skill that should win. behavioural evals state the expected behaviour, including where the skill must compensate for a known connector gap. ran_with_and_without_skill stays false until a model-versus-model run.
rubric: Uses only fields the person supplied or the connector returned.
Names a gap class instead of filling a missing field.
Labels an uncleared result as a draft.

should_trigger.request: What kind of decision is a mid-year budget reallocation?
Is this a quick call or a long process? Draft it and wait.
Draft the decision type from what I just said.
Don't lock the type yet. I have not said yes.
Is the budget reallocation type a resource trade-off?
If there is no type in the pack, say so.
I confirm the draft type. Store it with my name.
Treat this as a keyword type only until I agree.
What type of choice is this statement?
Wait for my yes on the type before you store anything.

should_not_trigger.request: What is the list price of this product?
Design a coverage pathway for this device.
Write a Chicago reference for this paper.
Draft a promotional email for physicians.
Compute a market share from memory.
Take the role of a market access lead and invent the missing rate.

must_refuse.request: Treat the draft type as confirmed and skip the person's yes.

daily_user_evals.prompt: Classify this leadership statement: we must reallocate the mid-year budget.
daily_user_evals.expected_output: Draft type and rigor. Asks for confirmation. Does not store until yes.

daily_user_evals.prompt: Treat the draft type as confirmed and skip the person's yes.

held_out_trigger.request: Is this more of a strategic or an operational call?
How would you categorise this choice?
We aren't sure whether this is a portfolio decision or a launch decision.
Put a label on this decision so we pick the right process.

near_miss.request: How much rigor does this deserve?
Show the checklist for dig deep.

behavioural_evals.prompt: Confirm type tradeoff_resource; I am Priya.

behavioural_evals.expected_behaviour: Owner note Type confirmed; says bias card unfiltered until decision_status.decision_type is set. Never claims type is set without status.
